126	    "- If the day or time is outside the window, say you can only call back today or on the next business day between 10:00 and 19:00, and ask once for another time.\n"
127	    "- If the second answer is also outside the window, or they cannot say when, do not book: call transition_to_fin_no_callback.\n"
128	    "After every tool result, speak or call the next tool.",
129	    tools=[cb_tool],
130	    extraction=[fl.ext("tp_status", ["none", "wrong_number", "deceased"],
131	                       "From the person's latest message: wrong_number if they say this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased if they say the customer has died; otherwise none.")],
132	    transitions=[
133	        fl.ok_true("schedule_callback", "fin_callback", "callback booked"),
134	        fl.eq("tp_status", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "customer died"),
135	        fl.eq("tp_status", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
136	        fl.intent_tool("fin_no_callback",
137	                       "No callback can be booked: the person gave a second time outside the allowed window, or cannot say when the customer is reachable.",
138	                       "No callback can be booked inside the allowed window"),
139	    ])
140	
141	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity
142	HINTS = {"day_month_swapped": "Day and month look swapped. This is NOT a wrong answer. Ask the customer to say the date of birth again with the month as a word, for example 14 March 1988."}
143	MAX_WRONG = "Three wrong answers. The check has ended. Say nothing about the account."
144	ALL_VERIFIED = "Both answers are correct. Identity verified."  # the brief's two questions (freyalib's default is generic)
145	
146	transfer_general = fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": "general"},
147	                               description="Transfer the call to a human colleague. CALL it only when the customer insists on a human after you asked once whether you can help.")
148	
149	ID_COMMON = ("Rules for this step:\n"
150	             "- Do not mention the reason for the call, collections, a debt, a payment, a product or an amount. If asked what the call is about or how much they owe, say you can explain right after the security questions.\n"
151	             "- If the customer asks a question back (why you need it, what this is about, who is calling): answer in one short sentence without naming the reason for the call, then say that these questions protect their account (a question instead of an answer counts as declining), then ask the same question again. If they refuse to answer: explain that these questions protect their account, and ask the question again.\n"
152	             "- If the customer asks for a human: the first time, ask whether you can help them yourself. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent.\n"
153	             "- After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next tool. Follow what_to_do_next.")
154	
155	REFUSAL_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only: refused if they refuse to answer the security question, say they do not want to talk, "
156	                "or ask the same thing back again instead of answering. none if they give an answer or say anything else." + fl.QUESTION_ENUM_CLAUSE + fl.REFUSAL_NONE_CLAUSE)
157	
158	nodes["ask_dob"] = fl.conv(
159	    "ask_dob",
160	    "The person confirmed they are {{title}} {{last_name}}. You must check identity with two security questions, one at a time. Now ask the first: their date of birth.\n"
161	    "When they give it, call verify_identity with answer = the date as YYYY-MM-DD, whatever way they said it. A date said only as numbers is day, then month, then year (05/03/1990 = 1990-03-05). "
162	    "If they give only part of the date, ask for the rest before calling the tool.\n" + ID_COMMON,
163	    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "date_of_birth"}, pre=fl.reset_pre(["question_count_dob"]),
164	                       description="Check the date of birth. CALL it every time the customer gives a full date of birth.",
165	                       field_descriptions={"answer": "The date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD."},
166	                       post=fl.verify_post("What is your date of birth?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED)), transfer_general],
167	    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_dob", ["none", "refused", "question"], REFUSAL_DESC)],
168	    transitions=[
169	        fl.eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0", "fin_failed", "three wrong answers"),
170	        fl.is_true("verify_identity_response.data.verified", "ask_phone", "date of birth correct"),
171	        fl.transferred("fin_transferred_human", "transferred"),
172	        fl.eq("refusal_dob", "refused", "count_decline_dob", "customer refused"),
173	        fl.eq("refusal_dob", "question", "qb_dob", "asks a question back"),
174	    ])
175	
176	nodes["ask_phone"] = fl.conv(
177	    "ask_phone",
178	    "The date of birth was correct. Now ask the second security question: the last four digits of the phone number on file.\n"
179	    "When they give four digits, call verify_identity with answer = the four digits only.\n" + ID_COMMON,
180	    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "phone_last4"}, pre=fl.reset_pre(["question_count_phone"]),
181	                       description="Check the last four digits of the phone number. CALL it every time the customer gives four digits.",
182	                       field_descriptions={"answer": "Exactly four digits."},
183	                       post=fl.verify_post("What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED)), transfer_general],
184	    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_phone", ["none", "refused", "question"], REFUSAL_DESC)],
185	    transitions=[
186	        fl.is_true("verify_identity_response.data.all_verified", "load_account", "identity verified"),
187	        fl.eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0", "fin_failed", "three wrong answers"),
188	        fl.transferred("fin_transferred_human", "transferred"),
189	        fl.eq("refusal_phone", "refused", "count_decline_phone", "customer refused"),
190	        fl.eq("refusal_phone", "question", "qb_phone", "asks a question back"),
191	    ])
192	
193	for stage in ["dob", "phone"]:
194	    nodes[f"qb_{stage}"] = fl.question_back_node(stage, f"ask_{stage}", "fin_declined")   # a question back: answer, ask again; twice in a row = deflection
195	    code = fl.counter_code("decline_count", 2, "decline_route", reset={"refusal_dob": "none", "refusal_phone": "none"})
196	    nodes[f"count_decline_{stage}"] = fl.code_node(f"count_decline_{stage}", code, [
197	        fl.eq("decline_route", "close", "fin_declined", "second refusal"), fl.always(f"ask_{stage}")])
198	
199	
200	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- payment: policy as code, one to three products
201	NOTE_ENUM = fl.tool_spec(API, "add_note")["fields"]["reason"]["enum"]
202	POLICY = pol.Policy(
203	    HOLIDAYS,
204	    texts={
205	        "question": "Can you pay [amount] [when]?",
206	        "tomorrow_when": "tomorrow, [date]",                                                                         # echo 'tomorrow' (A19 dates are checked in code)
207	        "question_product": "Can you pay [amount] [when] for your [words]?",                                       # B4 one by one
208	        "question_all": "Can you pay all of them today?",                                                           # B4
209	        "weekend_or_holiday": "[named] is not a business day, so I cannot record it. The next business day is [date].",   # A20
210	        "after_deadline": "The latest date I can record for your [words] is [deadline].",  # A23
211	        "before_today": "[named] has already passed.",
212	        "below_floor": "I cannot record [named]. The lowest amount I can record is [floor], your [floor_name].",       # A27
213	        "above_full": "The past-due amount is [full], so that is the most I can record.",
214	        "vague": "Which exact day would that be?",                                                                    # A21
215	        "vague_deadline": "The latest date I can record is [deadline].",
216	        "too_much_floor": "I understand. The lowest amount I can accept is [floor], the [floor_name]. The rest stays overdue.",  # A26
217	        "exhausted": "I understand.",                                                                                 # A31
218	        "one_by_one": "Let us go through them one by one.",                                                          # B4
219	        "next_product": "Next, your [words].",
220	        "paid": "Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear, so I will not take a promise for your [words].",  # A39, B9
221	        "dispute": "Thank you for telling me. I will not take a promise for your [words].",                          # A40, B9
222	        "hardship": "I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?",      # A32
223	        "human_first": "I can help you with most things myself. Is there anything I can help you with before I transfer you?",  # A42
224	        "notalk_first": "I understand. This will only take a moment.",                                               # A45
225	        "readback_head": "To confirm: your ",                                                                         # A34, B7: all together
226	        "readback_item": "[words], [amount], [when]",
227	        "readback_sep": "; your ",
228	        "own_deadline": ", which is the latest date I can record for it",                                            # B6
229	        "moved_bd": ", the next business day",
230	        "readback_tail": ". Do you confirm?",
231	        "recorded": "Your promise is recorded.",
232	        "recorded_many": "Your promises for your [list] are recorded.",
233	        "after_recorded": "You will receive a text message confirming this promise.",                                 # A38
234	        "rec_failed": "I could not record the promise for your [words] because of a technical problem.",             # B11
235	        "anything_else": "Is there anything else I can help you with?",
236	        "wrap_change": "A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call, but you can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.",  # A36
237	    },
238	    multi=True,                                                 # B1: one to three products
239	    notes=True,                                                 # B8: a note per product without a promise
240	    note_reasons={s: s for s in ("refused", "hardship", "dispute", "paid", "service_error") if s in NOTE_ENUM},
241	    notes_on_transfer=False,                                    # B10: on any transfer no notes at all, before or after it
242	    fin_keys={"promise": "promise", "paid": "paid", "default": "refused", "refused": "refused",
243	              "hardship": "hardship", "dispute": "dispute", "service_error": "service_error"},  # B closing
244	    fail_max=2, human_limit=2, notalk_limit=2, closed_day_move="after",
245	    asides={   # side questions answered before continuing, even on a turn that goes through code into a tts line
246	        "robot": {"when": "asks whether they are talking to a robot, a machine or an AI", "say": "Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant."},
247	        "scam": {"when": "asks whether this call is a scam or genuine", "say": "You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number."},
248	    })
249	
250	# Brief B: every product has its own band, deadline, floor and ladder (B3, B5); attempt 1 = the full amount (the
251	# floor once 'too much' was said) on the attempt-1 date, attempt 2 (late band) = the floor on that product's
252	# deadline (A30). Statement: one sentence per product, then one question for all (B2, B4).
253	PREPARE_BODY = fl.products_from_vars() + r'''
254	today = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('today_iso')))
255	a1 = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('attempt1_date')))
256	items = []
257	for i, p in enumerate(prods):
258	    if not isinstance(p, dict):
259	        continue
260	    ptype = str(p.get('type') or '')
261	    pid = str(p.get('product_id') or ('p' + str(i + 1)))
262	    if ptype == 'credit_card':
263	        words = 'credit card ending ' + str(p.get('card_last4') or '')
264	        floor = p.get('minimum_payment')
265	        floor_name = 'minimum payment'
266	    else:
267	        words = ptype.replace('_', ' ') if ptype else 'loan'
268	        floor = p.get('instalment_amount')
269	        floor_name = 'monthly instalment'
270	    past_due = float(p.get('past_due') or 0)
271	    try:
272	        floor = float(floor)
273	    except Exception:
274	        floor = past_due
275	    days_late = int(float(p.get('days_late') or 0))
276	    if days_late <= 7:
277	        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('early_deadline')))
278	        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1)]
279	    else:
280	        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('late_deadline')))
281	        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1), ('floor', deadline)]
282	    register_product(vars, pid, words, past_due, floor, floor_name, deadline, rungs)
283	    items.append((words, past_due, days_late, deadline))
284	name = str(vars.get('title') or '') + ' ' + str(vars.get('last_name') or '')
285	if len(items) == 1:
286	    w, pd, dl_, dd = items[0]
287	    statement = ('Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your ' + w + '. The past-due amount is '
288	                 + fmt(pd) + ', and it is ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. Can you make this payment today?')
289	else:
290	    statement = 'Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about late payments on ' + str(len(items)) + ' of your products. '
291	    for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
292	        statement += 'Your ' + w + ' has ' + fmt(pd) + ' past due, ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. '
293	    statement += 'Can you pay all of them today?'
294	lines = []
295	for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
296	    lines.append(w + ': past due ' + fmt(pd) + ', ' + str(dl_) + ' days late, latest date ' + txt_short(dd))
297	vars['products_facts'] = '; '.join(lines)
298	'''
299	PREPARE = POLICY.prepare_code(PREPARE_BODY, "statement", fallbacks={
300	    "say_next": "Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about late payments. Can you pay all of them today?",
301	    "products_facts": ""})
302	
303	nodes["load_account"] = fl.api_node(
304	    "load_account", fl.api_tool(API, "get_account", description="Get the late products.", retries=2),
305	    [fl.always("prepare")], mapping=[{"path": "data.products", "variable": "products"}])
306	nodes["prepare"] = fl.code_node("prepare", PREPARE, [fl.always("negotiate")])
307	
308	# ---- extraction, in the briefs' own terms
309	TOPIC_DESC = ("What the customer's LATEST message says, if it is one of these. "
310	              "hardship = mentions illness, a death in the family, or losing their job (this wins over every other value, even when they also name a date or an amount). "
311	              "already_paid = says they have ALREADY paid a past-due amount (not 'I will pay'). "
312	              "dispute = says a debt or a product is not theirs, they never had it, or it was closed or paid off in the past. "
313	              "new_plan = explicitly asks for a new payment plan, lower or smaller instalments, or restructuring. Saying an amount is too much is NOT new_plan; a different amount or date for a payment is NOT new_plan." + fl.PLAN_REQUEST_CLAUSE + " "
314	              "human = asks to speak to a person, a human, an agent or a colleague. "
315	              "no_talk = says they do not want to talk or do not want this call (not a refusal to pay). "
316	              "none = anything else: offers, yes or no answers, refusals to pay, questions.")
317	STANCE_DESC = ("The customer's answer to the agent's LATEST payment proposal, from the customer's latest message only. "
318	               "accept = agrees to exactly what the agent proposed ('yes', 'okay', 'fine', 'that works', 'I can do that'). "
319	               "refuse = a no with no date and no amount ('no', 'I can't', 'not today', 'I won't pay that'), or a non-answer that avoids the question ('I don't know', 'maybe'). "
320	               "too_much = says the amount is too much, too high, or that they cannot pay that much or all of it, without naming an amount. "
321	               "offer = names their own date, amount or period: a date or an amount the customer proposes is NEVER a refusal. "
322	               "other = anything else: a question, small talk, a request.")
323	KIND_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only. exact = they name a specific payment day (a date, a weekday, 'tomorrow', 'the 30th') or a specific amount of money, or both. "
324	             "vague = only a vague period without a day ('next week', 'end of the month', 'when my salary comes'). "
325	             "none = no date, amount or period in the latest message (also 'yes', 'no', questions).")
326	FOR_DESC = ("Which product the customer's LATEST message is about, in the order the agent listed the products: first, second or third "
327	            "(match the product they name, e.g. 'the credit card', 'the car loan'); pick that one even when they mention the other products only to "
328	            "refuse or exclude them ('the credit card tomorrow, not the loans' = first). all = all of them, everything, both, "
329	            "or one date or amount for everything. none = no product named.")
330	DATE_DESC = ("The payment date the customer names in their LATEST message. 'this <weekday>' is that weekday in the current Monday-to-Sunday week; "
331	             "'next <weekday>' is that weekday in the FOLLOWING calendar week. Leave it empty when the latest message names no specific day.")
332	AMOUNT_DESC = ("The amount of money the customer offers to pay in their LATEST message, as a number ('six forty' = 640). "
333	               "Leave it empty when the latest message names no amount. A day of the month is not an amount.")
334	REF_DESC = ("Whether the customer's LATEST message names the payment amount BY REFERENCE instead of as a number. "   # A25/A26: the floor by name
335	            "floor = the lowest amount the agent can accept: 'the minimum', 'the minimum payment', 'the instalment', 'the monthly instalment', 'the lowest amount'. "
336	            "full = the whole past-due amount ('all of it', 'the full amount', 'everything') ONLY when they offer to pay it; a message saying they cannot, will not or do not want to pay that amount is none. none = no such reference (also when they say a number).")
337	CONFIRM_DESC = ("The customer's answer to the read-back question 'Do you confirm?', from their latest message only. "
338	                "yes = a clear yes ('yes', 'correct', 'I confirm', 'that's right'). "
339	                "change = they give a different amount or a different date for a promise ('make it 250 instead', 'actually Monday'). "
340	                "no = a plain no without a new amount or date. other = anything else, for example a question.")
341	
342	topic = fl.ext("topic", ["none", "hardship", "already_paid", "dispute", "new_plan", "human", "no_talk"], TOPIC_DESC)
343	offer_for = fl.ext("offer_for", ["none", "all", "first", "second", "third"], FOR_DESC)
344	TOPIC_TRS = POLICY.topic_transitions()
345	
346	FACTS = ("FACTS\n- Products: {{products_facts}}.\n- Today: {{today_text}}.\n")
347	COMMON = ("- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: you are Freya Bank's digital assistant. If asked whether this is a scam: they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.\n"
348	          "- Never offer a discount, a waiver, a payment plan or any term that is not in STATE. If asked, say you cannot offer that.\n"
349	          "- A question these facts do not answer: say you do not have that information.\n"
350	          "- No tool call is allowed here. Never say that a promise is recorded.\n")
351	
352	NEGOTIATE = ("You are talking with {{title}} {{last_name}}, who is verified, about their late payments. The line you just said and the offer in STATE were decided by the system from the bank's rules.\n"
353	             "- Never propose, compute or change an amount or a date yourself, and never ask how much they can pay. The only offer you may make is the current offer in STATE, word for word.\n"
354	             "- If the customer asks a question or says something else, answer it in one short sentence, then ask the current offer again.\n"
355	             + COMMON + FACTS)
356	neg_ext = [topic, POLICY.stance_extraction(STANCE_DESC), offer_for] + POLICY.offer_extraction(DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, KIND_DESC, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
357	neg_trs = TOPIC_TRS + POLICY.offer_guard_transitions() + POLICY.stance_transitions()
358	nodes["negotiate"] = POLICY.negotiate_node(NEGOTIATE, neg_ext, neg_trs)
359	
360	CONFIRM = ("You read back the promises and asked \"Do you confirm?\". They are recorded only after a clear yes.\n"
361	           "- If the customer asks something, answer it in one short sentence, then ask again: \"Do you confirm?\".\n"
362	           + COMMON + FACTS)
363	nodes["confirm"] = POLICY.confirm_node(CONFIRM, CONFIRM_DESC, DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, topic_entry=topic, topic_trs=TOPIC_TRS, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
364	
365	HS_ANSWER_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message. support_yes = they want to be connected with the customer support team. "
366	                  "support_no = they do not want to be connected, say no to that offer, or say they cannot pay and want nothing more. "
367	                  "accept_offer = they agree to the date and amount the agent just proposed. "
368	                  "none = anything else, for example a question or a request for a discount.")
369	HARDSHIP = ("The customer mentioned a hardship (illness, a death in the family or job loss). You said one short sentence of sympathy and offered to connect them with the customer support team.\n"
370	            "- Make NO persuasion attempt. Never propose an amount or a date yourself.\n"
371	            "- If they ask a question or for a discount, answer in one short sentence and wait for their answer: the support team is offered once (on entering), never again.\n"
372	            + COMMON + FACTS)
373	nodes["hardship"] = POLICY.hardship_node(HARDSHIP, HS_ANSWER_DESC, KIND_DESC, DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
374	
375	WRAP_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message, after the agent said the promises are recorded and asked whether there is anything else. "
376	             "done = nothing else ('no', 'that's all', 'thanks', 'goodbye'). "
377	             "human = asks to speak to a person, a human or an agent, or insists on one. "
378	             "new_plan = asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments. "
379	             "change = asks to change, move or cancel a promise just recorded (another date or amount). "
380	             "question = asks a question. other = anything else.")
381	WRAPUP = ("The promises in STATE are recorded. You said so and asked whether there is anything else.\n"
382	          "- If the customer asks a question, answer it in one or two sentences from these facts or say you do not have that information, then ask whether there is anything else you can help with.\n"
383	          "- A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call; they can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.\n"
384	          + COMMON + FACTS)
385	nodes["wrapup"] = POLICY.wrapup_node(WRAPUP, WRAP_DESC)
386	
387	POLICY.add_event_nodes(nodes)
388	POLICY.record_nodes(nodes, API)
389	
390	for q, fin, line in [("restructuring", "fin_transferred_restructuring", "I cannot set up a new plan myself, but I will transfer you to the team that can help with that."),
391	                     ("support", "fin_transferred_support", "I will connect you with our customer support team now."),
392	                     ("general", "fin_transferred_human", "I will transfer you to a colleague now.")]:
393	    nodes[f"xfer_{q}"] = fl.api_node(
394	        f"xfer_{q}", fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": q}, description="Transfer.", retries=1),
395	        [fl.always(fin)], on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": line})
396	
397	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- close_call lifecycle
398	close_call = fl.close_call_tool(
399	    API,
400	    outcome_desc="promise: a promise was recorded. paid: says already paid. transferred: handed to a person. no_promise: verified, no promise. not_verified: identity not passed. not_reached: the customer was not reached.",
401	    reason_desc="transferred: restructuring|human|support. no_promise: refused|hardship|dispute|service_error. not_verified: failed|declined. not_reached: callback|no_callback|wrong_number|deceased|unclear. Empty for promise and paid.",
402	    no_reason_outcomes=("promise", "paid"))
403	
404	SYSTEM = ("You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on an outbound phone call to {{title}} {{last_name}}. Speak English. Keep every turn to one or two short sentences. Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}.\n"
405	          "Always:\n"
406	          "- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say \"Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.\", then continue.\n"
407	          "- If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue.\n"
408	          "- Never invent figures, dates or reasons. If you do not have the information, say so.\n"
409	          "- Never offer a discount, waiver, payment plan or any term you were not given.\n"
410	          "- Do not say goodbye or end the call yourself: the call is closed for you.\n"
411	          "- Call at most one tool per message. When a rule says to call a tool, call it: saying it is not enough.\n"
412	          "- After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next tool. Never end a turn with nothing. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.\n"
413	          "- Say amounts as plain numbers, for example 420.50, and dates as weekday, day and month, for example Friday 16 October.")
414	
415	wf = fl.assemble(INITIAL, nodes, SYSTEM, [close_call], conduct=True)   # no test_variables (CLAUDE.md); conduct = how customers talk
416	
417	if __name__ == "__main__":
418	    out = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ROOT / "out/brief-b_v3.workflow.json"
419	    fl.write_workflow(wf, out)
420	    print("nodes:", len(nodes), "->", out)

"""Brief B generator, v3: Brief A + Brief B (one to three products) on builder/policy.py. Writes out/brief-b_v3.workflow.json.

The port of out/gen_brief-b_lib.py onto the policy-as-code architecture of out/gen_brief-a_v3.py (see its docstring
and docs/research/sota-techniques.md T1, T2, T3, T20, T22, T26), conversation-first like gen_brief-a_v2.py:
- the statement names every late product, one sentence each, then asks once whether all can be paid today (B2, B4);
- a yes, or one date for everything, settles every product at once; a date after one product's deadline puts
  that product on its own deadline and the read-back says so (B6); otherwise the products are handled one by one
  in get_account order, each starting at attempt 1 with its own counters, band, floor and deadline (B3, B4, B5);
- paid / dispute settle one product and the call goes on (B9); one read-back for all agreed promises and one
  confirmation, then create_promise once per product in code (B7); a promise that fails twice keeps the others
  and gets a service_error note (B11); every other product without a promise gets add_note with its reason (B8);
- transfers add no notes (B10); the closing outcome follows the B closing rule (finalize in builder/policy.py).
Every Brief A/B value is in this file only."""
import pathlib, sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "builder"))
import freyalib as fl  # noqa: E402
import policy as pol  # noqa: E402

API = fl.load_api(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / "tools/openapi.json")
HOLIDAYS = ["2026-10-26", "2026-11-11", "2026-11-26", "2026-12-25", "2027-01-01"]  # from the brief, section 7

nodes = {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- terminals (rule 46 table; rule 47 goodbye)

# node said it (rule 38) right after create_promise returned ok.

for key, (outcome, reason, farewell) in FINS.items():
    fl.end_pair(key, outcome, reason, farewell, nodes)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup: dates
# Brief A: attempt 1 is the last business day of this week (else of next week); the early band may record up to
# 12 business days ahead, the late band up to 7 (rules 18, 30). Callbacks: today up to 19:00 or the next business
# day 10:00-19:00 (rule 6).
ATTEMPT_DATES = r'''
monday = today - datetime.timedelta(days=today.weekday())
a1 = lastbd_of_week(monday)
if a1 is None or a1 <= today:
    a1 = lastbd_of_week(monday + datetime.timedelta(days=7))
vars['attempt1_date'] = a1.isoformat()
vars['early_deadline'] = addbd(today, 12).isoformat()
vars['late_deadline'] = addbd(today, 7).isoformat()
'''
SETUP = fl.SETUP_CODE(HOLIDAYS, callback_rule={"open": "10:00", "close": "19:00", "same_day": True, "days_ahead": 1},
                      extra=ATTEMPT_DATES)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening
WHO_VALUES = ["customer", "someone_else", "wrong_number", "deceased", "refuses", "unclear"]
WHO_DESC = ("Who answered, judged ONLY from the person's latest message. "
            "customer = they confirm they are {{title}} {{last_name}}: 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking', or they say the customer's own name ({{first_name}} / {{last_name}}). "
            "someone_else = another person answered (a relative, partner, colleague), or says the customer is not here / not available, or offers to take a message. "
            "wrong_number = says this number does not belong to that person / they do not know them. "
            "deceased = says the customer has died / passed away. "
            "refuses = says they do not want to talk / not interested. "
            "unclear = anything else: 'hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this?', 'what is this about?', a question, silence.")

OPENING_ROUTES = [  # routed in `setup` on who1; anything else -> opening_retry
    ("customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
    ("deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
    ("wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
    ("someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
]
# The prompt quotes the opening line too: the chat route (local sim, smoke) replaces the initial node's tts with a
# model turn ("Suppressed: Missing prior assistant message"); simulations play the tts.
nodes["opening"] = fl.conv(
    "opening",
    "If you have not spoken yet, say exactly: \"Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?\" "
    "Do not call any tool in this turn. Do not say why you are calling.",
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": "Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"},
    extraction=[fl.ext("who1", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)], first_only=True)
INITIAL = fl.conversation_first("opening", SETUP, "who1", OPENING_ROUTES, "opening_retry", nodes)

nodes["opening_retry"] = fl.conv(
    "opening_retry",
    "You called {{title}} {{last_name}} and asked whether you are speaking with them, but the answer did not confirm it. "
    "No tool call is allowed in this turn. Do not say why you are calling, and do not mention any account, product, debt, payment or collections.\n"
    "If the person asked a question, answer it briefly first: who you are -> you are Freya Bank's digital assistant; a robot or AI -> 'Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.'; "
    "a scam -> they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number; what it is about -> you can only discuss that with {{title}} {{last_name}}. "
    "If they said they do not want to talk, say you only need a moment. "
    "Then ask exactly: \"Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?\"",
    extraction=[fl.ext("who2", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.eq("who2", "customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
        fl.eq("who2", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
        fl.eq("who2", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.eq("who2", "someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
        fl.eq("who2", "refuses", "fin_declined", "refuses again"),
        fl.always("fin_unclear"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- third party
cb_tool = fl.api_tool(
    API, "schedule_callback",
    description="Book a callback for the customer. CALL it as soon as the person names a day and time inside the allowed window.",
    field_descriptions={"date": "Callback date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be one of the allowed days.",
                        "time": "Callback time as HH:MM, 24 hour, between 10:00 and 19:00."},
    post=fl.ok_post("Callback booked.", "The booking failed. Try schedule_callback once more with the same values."))

nodes["third_party"] = fl.conv(
    "third_party",
    "You called for {{title}} {{last_name}} ({{first_name}}) but someone else is on the line.\n"
    "STRICT: Never say why you are calling. Never mention the bank account, a product, a debt, an amount, a payment or collections, even if they ask or offer to pay or help. "
    "If they ask what it is about, say you can only discuss it with {{title}} {{last_name}} personally. Do not ask them any security question.\n"
    "Your only job: ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached, then book a callback.\n"

If they give only a day, ask for a time; if only a vague time like 'morning', propose a precise time such as 11:00 and ask if it suits.\n"
    "- If the day or time is outside the window, say you can only call back today or on the next business day between 10:00 and 19:00, and ask once for another time.\n"
    "- If the second answer is also outside the window, or they cannot say when, do not book: call transition_to_fin_no_callback.\n"
    "After every tool result, speak or call the next tool.",
    tools=[cb_tool],
    extraction=[fl.ext("tp_status", ["none", "wrong_number", "deceased"],
                       "From the person's latest message: wrong_number if they say this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased if they say the customer has died; otherwise none.")],
    transitions=[
        fl.ok_true("schedule_callback", "fin_callback", "callback booked"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "customer died"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.intent_tool("fin_no_callback",
                       "No callback can be booked: the person gave a second time outside the allowed window, or cannot say when the customer is reachable.",
                       "No callback can be booked inside the allowed window"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity
HINTS = {"day_month_swapped": "Day and month look swapped. This is NOT a wrong answer. Ask the customer to say the date of birth again with the month as a word, for example 14 March 1988."}
MAX_WRONG = "Three wrong answers. The check has ended. Say nothing about the account."
ALL_VERIFIED = "Both answers are correct. Identity verified."  # the brief's two questions (freyalib's default is generic)

transfer_general = fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": "general"},
                               description="Transfer the call to a human colleague. CALL it only when the customer insists on a human after you asked once whether you can help.")

ID_COMMON = ("Rules for this step:\n"
             "- Do not mention the reason for the call, collections, a debt, a payment, a product or an amount. If asked what the call is about or how much they owe, say you can explain right after the security questions.\n"
             "- If the customer asks a question back (why you need it, what this is about, who is calling): answer in one short sentence without naming the reason for the call, then say that these questions protect their account (a question instead of an answer counts as declining), then ask the same question again. If they refuse to answer: explain that these questions protect their account, and ask the question again.\n"
             "- If the customer asks for a human: the first time, ask whether you can help them yourself. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent.\n"

REFUSAL_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only: refused if they refuse to answer the security question, say they do not want to talk, "
                "or ask the same thing back again instead of answering. none if they give an answer or say anything else." + fl.QUESTION_ENUM_CLAUSE + fl.REFUSAL_NONE_CLAUSE)

nodes["ask_dob"] = fl.conv(
    "ask_dob",
    "The person confirmed they are {{title}} {{last_name}}. You must check identity with two security questions, one at a time. Now ask the first: their date of birth.\n"
    "When they give it, call verify_identity with answer = the date as YYYY-MM-DD, whatever way they said it. A date said only as numbers is day, then month, then year (05/03/1990 = 1990-03-05). "
    "If they give only part of the date, ask for the rest before calling the tool.\n" + ID_COMMON,
    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "date_of_birth"}, pre=fl.reset_pre(["question_count_dob"]),
                       description="Check the date of birth. CALL it every time the customer gives a full date of birth.",
                       field_descriptions={"answer": "The date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD."},
                       post=fl.verify_post("What is your date of birth?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED)), transfer_general],
    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_dob", ["none", "refused", "question"], REFUSAL_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0", "fin_failed", "three wrong answers"),
        fl.is_true("verify_identity_response.data.verified", "ask_phone", "date of birth correct"),
        fl.transferred("fin_transferred_human", "transferred"),
        fl.eq("refusal_dob", "refused", "count_decline_dob", "customer refused"),
        fl.eq("refusal_dob", "question", "qb_dob", "asks a question back"),
    ])

nodes["ask_phone"] = fl.conv(
    "ask_phone",
    "The date of birth was correct. Now ask the second security question: the last four digits of the phone number on file.\n"
    "When they give four digits, call verify_identity with answer = the four digits only.\n" + ID_COMMON,
    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "phone_last4"}, pre=fl.reset_pre(["question_count_phone"]),
                       description="Check the last four digits of the phone number. CALL it every time the customer gives four digits.",
                       field_descriptions={"answer": "Exactly four digits."},
                       post=fl.verify_post("What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED)), transfer_general],
    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_phone", ["none", "refused", "question"], REFUSAL_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.is_true("verify_identity_response.data.all_verified", "load_account", "identity verified"),
        fl.eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0", "fin_failed", "three wrong answers"),
        fl.transferred("fin_transferred_human", "transferred"),
        fl.eq("refusal_phone", "refused", "count_decline_phone", "customer refused"),
        fl.eq("refusal_phone", "question", "qb_phone", "asks a question back"),
    ])

for stage in ["dob", "phone"]:
    nodes[f"qb_{stage}"] = fl.question_back_node(stage, f"ask_{stage}", "fin_declined")   # a question back: answer, ask again; twice in a row = deflection
    code = fl.counter_code("decline_count", 2, "decline_route", reset={"refusal_dob": "none", "refusal_phone": "none"})
    nodes[f"count_decline_{stage}"] = fl.code_node(f"count_decline_{stage}", code, [
        fl.eq("decline_route", "close", "fin_declined", "second refusal"), fl.always(f"ask_{stage}")])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- payment: policy as code, one to three products
NOTE_ENUM = fl.tool_spec(API, "add_note")["fields"]["reason"]["enum"]
POLICY = pol.Policy(

    texts={

        "tomorrow_when": "tomorrow, [date]",                                                                         # echo 'tomorrow' (A19 dates are checked in code)
        "question_product": "Can you pay [amount] [when] for your [words]?",                                       # B4 one by one
        "question_all": "Can you pay all of them today?",                                                           # B4

        "hardship": "I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?",      # A32
        "human_first": "I can help you with most things myself. Is there anything I can help you with before I transfer you?",  # A42
        "notalk_first": "I understand. This will only take a moment.",                                               # A45
        "readback_head": "To confirm: your ",                                                                         # A34, B7: all together
        "readback_item": "[words], [amount], [when]",

        "anything_else": "Is there anything else I can help you with?",

    },
    multi=True,                                                 # B1: one to three products
    notes=True,                                                 # B8: a note per product without a promise
    note_reasons={s: s for s in ("refused", "hardship", "dispute", "paid", "service_error") if s in NOTE_ENUM},
    notes_on_transfer=False,                                    # B10: on any transfer no notes at all, before or after it
    fin_keys={"promise": "promise", "paid": "paid", "default": "refused", "refused": "refused",

# Brief B: every product has its own band, deadline, floor and ladder (B3, B5); attempt 1 = the full amount (the
# floor once 'too much' was said) on the attempt-1 date, attempt 2 (late band) = the floor on that product's
# deadline (A30). Statement: one sentence per product, then one question for all (B2, B4).
PREPARE_BODY = fl.products_from_vars() + r'''
today = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('today_iso')))
a1 = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('attempt1_date')))
items = []
for i, p in enumerate(prods):
    if not isinstance(p, dict):
        continue
    ptype = str(p.get('type') or '')
    pid = str(p.get('product_id') or ('p' + str(i + 1)))
    if ptype == 'credit_card':
        words = 'credit card ending ' + str(p.get('card_last4') or '')
        floor = p.get('minimum_payment')
        floor_name = 'minimum payment'
    else:
        words = ptype.replace('_', ' ') if ptype else 'loan'
        floor = p.get('instalment_amount')
        floor_name = 'monthly instalment'
    past_due = float(p.get('past_due') or 0)
    try:
        floor = float(floor)
    except Exception:
        floor = past_due
    days_late = int(float(p.get('days_late') or 0))
    if days_late <= 7:
        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('early_deadline')))
        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1)]
    else:
        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('late_deadline')))
        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1), ('floor', deadline)]
    register_product(vars, pid, words, past_due, floor, floor_name, deadline, rungs)
    items.append((words, past_due, days_late, deadline))
name = str(vars.get('title') or '') + ' ' + str(vars.get('last_name') or '')
if len(items) == 1:
    w, pd, dl_, dd = items[0]
    statement = ('Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your ' + w + '. The past-due amount is '
                 + fmt(pd) + ', and it is ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. Can you make this payment today?')
else:
    statement = 'Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about late payments on ' + str(len(items)) + ' of your products. '
    for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
        statement += 'Your ' + w + ' has ' + fmt(pd) + ' past due, ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. '
    statement += 'Can you pay all of them today?'
lines = []
for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
    lines.append(w + ': past due ' + fmt(pd) + ', ' + str(dl_) + ' days late, latest date ' + txt_short(dd))
vars['products_facts'] = '; '.join(lines)
'''
PREPARE = POLICY.prepare_code(PREPARE_BODY, "statement", fallbacks={
    "say_next": "Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about late payments. Can you pay all of them today?",
    "products_facts": ""})

nodes["load_account"] = fl.api_node(
    "load_account", fl.api_tool(API, "get_account", description="Get the late products.", retries=2),
    [fl.always("prepare")], mapping=[{"path": "data.products", "variable": "products"}])
nodes["prepare"] = fl.code_node("prepare", PREPARE, [fl.always("negotiate")])

# ---- extraction, in the briefs' own terms
TOPIC_DESC = ("What the customer's LATEST message says, if it is one of these. "
              "hardship = mentions illness, a death in the family, or losing their job (this wins over every other value, even when they also name a date or an amount). "

              "dispute = says a debt or a product is not theirs, they never had it, or it was closed or paid off in the past. "

             "- Never propose, compute or change an amount or a date yourself, and never ask how much they can pay. The only offer you may make is the current offer in STATE, word for word.\n"

                  "none = anything else, for example a question or a request for a discount.")

            "- Make NO persuasion attempt. Never propose an amount or a date yourself.\n"
            "- If they ask a question or for a discount, answer in one short sentence and wait for their answer: the support team is offered once (on entering), never again.\n"
            + COMMON + FACTS)

             "change = asks to change, move or cancel a promise just recorded (another date or amount). "

WRAPUP = ("The promises in STATE are recorded. You said so and asked whether there is anything else.\n"
          "- If the customer asks a question, answer it in one or two sentences from these facts or say you do not have that information, then ask whether there is anything else you can help with.\n"
          "- A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call; they can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.\n"
          + COMMON + FACTS)
nodes["wrapup"] = POLICY.wrapup_node(WRAPUP, WRAP_DESC)

                     ("support", "fin_transferred_support", "I will connect you with our customer support team now."),

    no_reason_outcomes=("promise", "paid"))

return a, d
def back_route(V):
    return 'hardship' if g(V, 'mode') == 'hardship' else 'negotiate'
def say(V, text, route=None):
    V['say_next'] = text
    V['route'] = route or back_route(V)
def register_product(V, pid, words, full, floor, floor_name, deadline, rungs):
    pid = str(pid)
    ids = pids(V)
    if pid not in ids:
        ids.append(pid)
    V['pids_csv'] = ','.join(ids)
    pset(V, pid, 'words', words)
    pset(V, pid, 'full', float(full))
    pset(V, pid, 'floor', float(floor))
    pset(V, pid, 'floor_name', floor_name)
    pset(V, pid, 'deadline', deadline.isoformat())
    lad = []
    for r in rungs:
        rd = r[1]
        if rd > deadline:
            rd = deadline
        lad.append([str(r[0]), rd.isoformat()])
    pset(V, pid, 'ladder', json.dumps(lad))
    for k, v in (('state', 'open'), ('attempts_used', '0'), ('too_much', 'no'), ('offered_floor', 'no'),
                 ('refused_offers', ''), ('agreed', ''), ('vague_asked', 'no'), ('checks', '0'), ('fails', '0'),
                 ('noted', 'no')):
        pset(V, pid, k, v)
def init_negotiation(V, statement):
    ids = pids(V)
    V['mode'] = 'negotiate'
    V['stage'] = 'all' if multi(V) else 'one'
    V['cur_pid'] = ids[0] if ids else ''
    V['human_count'] = '0'
    V['notalk_count'] = '0'
    V['wrap_count'] = '0'
    V['wrap_human'] = '0'
    V['vague_all'] = 'no'
    V['hs_offer'] = 'no'
    V['same_change'] = '0'
    V['wrap_done'] = 'no'
    if ids:
        a, d = prop_of(V, ids[0])
        set_prop(V, ids[0], a, d)
    if V['stage'] == 'all':
        V['offer_question'] = T('question_all')
    V['say_next'] = statement
    V['route'] = 'negotiate'
    finish_turn(V)
def readback(V, ids):
    items = []
    for p in ids:
        parts = pg(V, p, 'agreed').split('|')
        a = num(parts[0], 0.0) if parts else 0.0
        d = pdate(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else None
        tag = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ''
        if d is None:
            continue
        s = T('readback_item', words=pg(V, p, 'words'), amount=fmt(a), when=when(V, d), date=txt_short(d))
        if tag == 'dl':
            s += T('own_deadline')
        self.asides = {str(k): {"when": str(v.get("when") or ""), "say": str(v.get("say") or "")} for k, v in (asides or {}).items()}
        self.P = {"texts": t, "multi": self.multi, "notes": self.notes, "note_reasons": nr, "fin_keys": fk, "asides": self.asides, "weekday_rule": str(weekday_rule),
                  "fail_max": int(fail_max), "defer_notes": bool(notes) and not notes_on_transfer, "max_checks": int(max_checks), "human_limit": int(human_limit),
                  "notalk_limit": int(notalk_limit), "wrap_turns": int(wrap_turns),
                  "closed_day_move": closed_day_move, "ordinals": list(ordinals),
                  "clear_enums": dict(CLEAR_ENUMS), "clear_values": dict(CLEAR_VALUES),
                  "outcome_var": outcome_var, "reason_var": reason_var, "promise_outcome": promise_outcome,
                  "now_var": now_var, "after_recorded": bool(t.get("after_recorded")),
                  "vague_again": vague_again, "above_full": above_full, "promise_reasons": pr}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ sources
    def core(self):
        """CAL_HELPERS + the policy core (functions only, nothing runs)."""
        src = fl.CAL_HELPERS(self.holidays, self.bwd, self.P.get("weekday_rule", "this_week")) + _CORE.replace("__P__", _pylit(self.P))
        if "{{" in src or "}}" in src:
            raise ValueError("policy core contains '{{' or '}}'")
        return src

    def event_code(self, event):
        """The source of a policy code node: core + main(vars, event), the whole body inside one try (a failing
        core still leaves a route and a state_line), every variable the core writes declared with setdefault."""
        body = self.core() + "\nmain(vars, %r)\n" % event + _declare()
        return ("try:\n%s\nexcept Exception as e:\n    vars['policy_state'] = 'error ' + str(e)\n"
                "    vars.setdefault('route', 'negotiate')\n    vars.setdefault('state_line', '')\n" % fl._indent(body, 4))

    def prepare_code(self, body, statement_expr, fallbacks=None, state_var="prepare_state"):
        """The prepare node: core + a guarded brief-specific `body` that reads the products (e.g. with
        freyalib.products_from_vars()), computes the brief's facts and calls, per product in get_account order,
        register_product(vars, pid, words, full, floor, floor_name, deadline_date, rungs)
        with rungs = [(amount_rule, date), ...] the brief's persuasion ladder (amount_rule in AMOUNT_RULES:
        'full_or_floor' = the floor once the customer said the full amount is too much; a rung date after the
        deadline is capped to it). Then init_negotiation(vars, <statement_expr>) with the statement of the debt
        (a Python expression over the body's names). `today` must be a datetime.date in the body."""
        fb = {"say_next": "", "state_line": "", "offer_question": "", "route": "negotiate"}
        fb.update(fallbacks or {})
        inner = self.core() + body.strip("\n") + "\ninit_negotiation(vars, %s)\n" % statement_expr + _declare()
        return fl.guarded(inner, state_var, fb)

    def ending_code(self, outcome, reason, promise_decides=True):
        """Code of a fin_<key> node: writes outcome/reason; with promise_decides, a promise recorded earlier in the
        call wins ("if a transfer takes place after a promise was recorded, the promise decides"): promise_outcome
        and the promise reason the core wrote (promise_reason). Use it for the promise ending itself too
        (ending_code(promise_outcome, <default reason>))."""
        ov, rv, po = self.P["outcome_var"], self.P["reason_var"], self.P["promise_outcome"]
        return ("try:\n    rec = str(vars.get('recorded_pids') or '').strip()\n"
                "    if %r and rec and rec.lower() not in ('none', 'null'):\n"
                "        vars[%r] = %r\n        vars[%r] = str(vars.get('promise_reason') or %r)\n"
                "        if vars[%r].lower() in ('none', 'null'):\n            vars[%r] = %r\n"
                "    else:\n        vars[%r] = %r\n        vars[%r] = %r\nexcept Exception:\n    pass\n"
                % (bool(promise_decides), ov, po, rv, reason if outcome == po else "", rv, rv,
                   reason if outcome == po else "", ov, outcome, rv, reason))

    def end_pair(self, key, outcome, reason, farewell, nodes, promise_decides=True):
        """freyalib.end_pair whose fin_<key> runs ending_code (a recorded promise decides the ending)."""
        fin, end = fl.end_pair(key, outcome, reason, farewell, nodes, self.P["outcome_var"], self.P["reason_var"])
        nodes[fin] = fl.code_node(fin, self.ending_code(outcome, reason, promise_decides), [fl.always(end)])
        return fin, end

"""Generator for slot `harrow` (Corran Bay Bank pack: mail + AHS-5 s.5 + 9 Oct minutes + dialler code card).
Structure of out/gen_brief-b_v3.py (policy as code, 1-3 products, notes); every value and sentence from the brief,
with the 9 Oct minutes in force (Middle band = 4th business day, card floor = half past_due rounded up to 5,
cut-over closure 6 Nov instead of 13 Nov). Usage: python3 out/gen_harrow.py <api.json> [out.json]"""
import json, pathlib, sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "builder"))
import freyalib as fl  # noqa: E402
import policy as pol  # noqa: E402

API = fl.load_api(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / "tools/openapi.json")
SPEC = json.load(open(ROOT / "out/harrow.spec.json"))["spec"]
HOLIDAYS = [h["date"] for h in SPEC["calendar"]["holidays"]]   # R44/R71: 2026-11-06 replaces 2026-11-13
assert "2026-11-06" in HOLIDAYS and "2026-11-13" not in HOLIDAYS

nodes = {}
BANK = "Corran Bay Bank"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- terminals: the dialler code card (R75, R95)
NAME = "{{title}} {{last_name}}"
XFER = "I am putting you through now. Please stay on the line."
FINS = {
    "promise": ("promise", "FULLPTP", "Thank you, " + NAME + ". Your arrangement is in place. Goodbye."),
    "paid": ("paid", "CLMPD", "Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_restructuring": ("transferred", "XRST", "Goodbye."),
    "transferred_human": ("transferred", "XGEN", "Goodbye."),
    "transferred_support": ("transferred", "XCARE", "Goodbye."),
    "tdn": ("no_promise", "TDN", "Thank you for your time, " + NAME + ". Goodbye."),
    "tdn2l": ("no_promise", "TDN2L", "Your second-look call is booked for {{second_look_text}} at {{sl_time}}. Thank you for your time, " + NAME + ". Speak to you then. Goodbye."),
    "hardship": ("no_promise", "HDNX", "Thank you for telling me. Take care, " + NAME + ". Goodbye."),
    "dispute": ("no_promise", "DSPT", "We will look into this and write to you. Goodbye."),
    "sysf": ("no_promise", "SYSF", "I'm sorry, our system is not responding. We will call you again. Goodbye."),
    "failed": ("not_verified", "IDNO", "For your security I cannot continue on this call. You can use the Corran Bay app or visit any branch. Goodbye."),
    "declined": ("not_verified", "IDREF", "I understand. You can use the Corran Bay app or visit any branch. Goodbye."),
    "callback": ("not_reached", "TPCB", "Thank you, we will call back then. Goodbye."),
    "nocon": ("not_reached", "NOCON", "Thank you. Goodbye."),
    "deceased": ("not_reached", "NOCON", "I am very sorry to hear that. Thank you. Goodbye."),
}
POLICY_FINS = {"promise", "paid", "transferred_restructuring", "transferred_human", "transferred_support", "tdn", "tdn2l", "hardship", "dispute", "sysf"}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup: dates (R44-R62, R69)
EXTRA = r'''
def nth_bd(d, n):
    return addbd(d, n)
e = today + datetime.timedelta(days=14)
while not isbd(e):
    e = e + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
vars['early_deadline'] = e.isoformat()
vars['middle_deadline'] = addbd(today, 4).isoformat()
vars['late_deadline'] = addbd(today, 3).isoformat()
vars['late_a1'] = addbd(today, 1).isoformat()
vars['part_deadline'] = addbd(today, 2).isoformat()
sl = addbd(today, 3)
vars['second_look_date'] = sl.isoformat()
vars['second_look_text'] = sl.strftime('%A') + ' ' + str(sl.day) + ' ' + sl.strftime('%B')
'''
SETUP = fl.SETUP_CODE(HOLIDAYS, callback_rule={"open": "10:00", "close": "16:00", "same_day": False, "days_ahead": 2},
                      extra=EXTRA, fallbacks={"second_look_text": "the third business day from today", "second_look_date": "2026-10-19"})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening (R07-R12)
WHO_VALUES = ["customer", "someone_else", "wrong_number", "deceased", "refuses", "unclear"]
WHO_DESC = ("Who answered, judged ONLY from the person's latest message. "
            "customer = 'yes', 'speaking', 'that's me', or they say the customer's own name ({{first_name}} / {{last_name}}). "
            "someone_else = another person answered (relative, partner, flatmate), or says the customer is not here / not available. "
            "wrong_number = this number does not belong to that person / they do not know them. "
            "deceased = says the customer has died. "
            "refuses = says they do not want to talk. "
            "unclear = anything else: 'hello?', 'who wants to know?', 'what's this about?', any question, silence.")
OPENING_ROUTES = [
    ("customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
    ("deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
    ("wrong_number", "fin_nocon", "wrong number"),
    ("someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
]
OPEN_LINE = "Hello, this is the automated assistant of Corran Bay Bank. This call may be recorded. Could I speak to {{first_name}} {{last_name}}, please?"
nodes["opening"] = fl.conv(
    "opening",
    "If you have not spoken yet, say exactly: \"" + OPEN_LINE + "\" Do not call any tool in this turn. Do not say why you are calling.",
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": OPEN_LINE},
    extraction=[fl.ext("who1", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)], first_only=True)
INITIAL = fl.conversation_first("opening", SETUP, "who1", OPENING_ROUTES, "opening_retry", nodes)

ASIDES_TXT = ("If the person asked whether this is a robot: say \"Yes, I am an automated assistant.\" "
              "If they asked whether this is a scam: say they are free to hang up and call us on the number on the Corran Bay website. ")
FORBID = ("Never say any of these words: overdue, arrears, missed, owe, debt, balance, payment, account, card, credit card, loan, car loan. "
          "Never say why you are calling or which department. ")
nodes["opening_retry"] = fl.conv(
    "opening_retry",
    "You asked to speak to {{first_name}} {{last_name}}, but it is not clear who answered. No tool call in this turn. " + FORBID +
    ASIDES_TXT + "If they asked what this is about or who wants to know: say you are the automated assistant of Corran Bay Bank with a personal message for {{first_name}} {{last_name}}. "
    "If they said they do not want to talk: say \"This will only take a moment.\" "
    "Then ask exactly once more: \"Could I speak to {{first_name}} {{last_name}}, please?\"",
    extraction=[fl.ext("who2", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.eq("who2", "customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
        fl.eq("who2", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
        fl.eq("who2", "wrong_number", "fin_nocon", "wrong number"),
        fl.eq("who2", "someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
        fl.eq("who2", "refuses", "fin_declined", "refuses again"),
        fl.always("fin_nocon"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- third party (R13-R17, R61)
cb_tool = fl.api_tool(
    API, "schedule_callback",
    description="Book a callback for the customer. CALL it as soon as the person agrees a day and time inside the allowed window.",
    field_descriptions={"date": "Callback date as YYYY-MM-DD, one of the allowed days.",
                        "time": "Callback time as HH:MM, 24 hour, from 10:00 to 16:00."},
    pre=fl.normalise_pre({"time": "time"}, date_order="dmy"),
    post=fl.ok_post("Callback booked.", "The booking failed. Try schedule_callback once more with the same values."))
nodes["third_party"] = fl.conv(
    "third_party",
    "You called for {{title}} {{last_name}} but someone else is on the line.\n" + FORBID +
    "Say that you are calling with a personal message for {{title}} {{last_name}}, and ask when they will be available. Nothing else.\n"
    "If they offer to answer questions, pay or arrange anything for the customer: thank them, decline, and ask again when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached.\n"
    + ASIDES_TXT + "\nNow: {{today_text}}, {{now_time}}. We never call back today.\n{{callback_text}}\n"
    "- If they name a day and time inside the window, call schedule_callback (date YYYY-MM-DD, time HH:MM).\n"
    "- If it does not fit, propose ONCE the nearest slot that fits: the same time on the first allowed day, or if the time is outside 10:00-16:00 the nearest end of those hours (10:00 or 16:00). If they accept, book it.\n"
    "- If they turn down your proposal or cannot say when, book nothing: call transition_to_fin_nocon.\n"
    "After every tool result, speak or call the next tool.",
    tools=[cb_tool],
    extraction=[fl.ext("tp_status", ["none", "wrong_number", "deceased"],
                       "From the person's latest message: wrong_number if this number is not the customer's; deceased if the customer has died; otherwise none.")],
    transitions=[
        fl.ok_true("schedule_callback", "fin_callback", "callback booked"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "customer died"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "wrong_number", "fin_nocon", "wrong number"),
        fl.intent_tool("fin_nocon", "No callback will be booked: the person turned down the one proposed slot, or cannot say when.",
                       "No callback booked"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity (R18-R22)
HINTS = {"day_month_swapped": "Day and month look swapped. NOT a wrong answer. Ask for the date of birth again with the month as a word, for example 14 March 1988."}
LIMIT_TXT = "The check has ended. Say nothing about why you called."
transfer_general = fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": "general"},
                               description="Transfer to a person. CALL it only when the customer asks for a person AGAIN after you asked once whether they are happy to continue with you.")

"""Brief B generator, v3: Brief A + Brief B (one to three products) on builder/policy.py. Writes out/brief-b_v3.workflow.json.

The port of out/gen_brief-b_lib.py onto the policy-as-code architecture of out/gen_brief-a_v3.py (see its docstring
and docs/research/sota-techniques.md T1, T2, T3, T20, T22, T26), conversation-first like gen_brief-a_v2.py:
- the statement names every late product, one sentence each, then asks once whether all can be paid today (B2, B4);
- a yes, or one date for everything, settles every product at once; a date after one product's deadline puts
  that product on its own deadline and the read-back says so (B6); otherwise the products are handled one by one
  in get_account order, each starting at attempt 1 with its own counters, band, floor and deadline (B3, B4, B5);
- paid / dispute settle one product and the call goes on (B9); one read-back for all agreed promises and one
  confirmation, then create_promise once per product in code (B7); a promise that fails twice keeps the others
  and gets a service_error note (B11); every other product without a promise gets add_note with its reason (B8);
- transfers add no notes (B10); the closing outcome follows the B closing rule (finalize in builder/policy.py).
Every Brief A/B value is in this file only."""
import pathlib, sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "builder"))
import freyalib as fl  # noqa: E402
import policy as pol  # noqa: E402

API = fl.load_api(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / "tools/openapi.json")
HOLIDAYS = ["2026-10-26", "2026-11-11", "2026-11-26", "2026-12-25", "2027-01-01"]  # from the brief, section 7

nodes = {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- terminals (rule 46 table; rule 47 goodbye)
# key: (outcome, reason, farewell). The promise farewell no longer repeats the recorded sentence: the wrap-up
# node said it (rule 38) right after create_promise returned ok.
FINS = {
    "promise": ("promise", "", "Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "paid": ("paid", "", "Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear, so I will not take a promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_restructuring": ("transferred", "restructuring", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_human": ("transferred", "human", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_support": ("transferred", "support", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague from customer support will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "refused": ("no_promise", "refused", "I understand. I have not recorded a promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "hardship": ("no_promise", "hardship", "I understand. I have not recorded a promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}, and take care. Goodbye."),
    "dispute": ("no_promise", "dispute", "Thank you for telling me. I will not take a payment promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "service_error": ("no_promise", "service_error", "I am sorry, I could not record your promise because of a technical problem. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "failed": ("not_verified", "failed", "I am sorry, I could not verify your identity, so I cannot continue. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "declined": ("not_verified", "declined", "I understand. Without the security questions I cannot continue. Thank you for your time, goodbye."),
    "callback": ("not_reached", "callback", "Thank you, we will call back then. Goodbye."),
    "no_callback": ("not_reached", "no_callback", "Thank you for your help. Goodbye."),
    "wrong_number": ("not_reached", "wrong_number", "I apologise for the inconvenience. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "deceased": ("not_reached", "deceased", "I am sorry for your loss. Goodbye."),
    "unclear": ("not_reached", "unclear", "I am sorry, I could not confirm who I am speaking with. Thank you, goodbye."),
}
for key, (outcome, reason, farewell) in FINS.items():
    fl.end_pair(key, outcome, reason, farewell, nodes)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup: dates
# Brief A: attempt 1 is the last business day of this week (else of next week); the early band may record up to
# 12 business days ahead, the late band up to 7 (rules 18, 30). Callbacks: today up to 19:00 or the next business
# day 10:00-19:00 (rule 6).
ATTEMPT_DATES = r'''
monday = today - datetime.timedelta(days=today.weekday())
a1 = lastbd_of_week(monday)
if a1 is None or a1 <= today:
    a1 = lastbd_of_week(monday + datetime.timedelta(days=7))
vars['attempt1_date'] = a1.isoformat()
vars['early_deadline'] = addbd(today, 12).isoformat()
vars['late_deadline'] = addbd(today, 7).isoformat()
'''
SETUP = fl.SETUP_CODE(HOLIDAYS, callback_rule={"open": "10:00", "close": "19:00", "same_day": True, "days_ahead": 1},
                      extra=ATTEMPT_DATES)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening

WHO_DESC = ("Who answered, judged ONLY from the person's latest message. "
            "customer = they confirm they are {{title}} {{last_name}}: 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking', or they say the customer's own name ({{first_name}} / {{last_name}}). "
            "someone_else = another person answered (a relative, partner, colleague), or says the customer is not here / not available, or offers to take a message. "
            "wrong_number = says this number does not belong to that person / they do not know them. "
            "deceased = says the customer has died / passed away. "
            "refuses = says they do not want to talk / not interested. "

OPENING_ROUTES = [  # routed in `setup` on who1; anything else -> opening_retry
    ("customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),

    ("someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
]
# The prompt quotes the opening line too: the chat route (local sim, smoke) replaces the initial node's tts with a
# model turn ("Suppressed: Missing prior assistant message"); simulations play the tts.
nodes["opening"] = fl.conv(
    "opening",
    "If you have not spoken yet, say exactly: \"Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?\" "
    "Do not call any tool in this turn. Do not say why you are calling.",
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": "Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"},
    extraction=[fl.ext("who1", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)], first_only=True)
INITIAL = fl.conversation_first("opening", SETUP, "who1", OPENING_ROUTES, "opening_retry", nodes)

nodes["opening_retry"] = fl.conv(
    "opening_retry",

    "If the person asked a question, answer it briefly first: who you are -> you are Freya Bank's digital assistant; a robot or AI -> 'Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.'; "
    "a scam -> they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number; what it is about -> you can only discuss that with {{title}} {{last_name}}. "

cb_tool = fl.api_tool(
    API, "schedule_callback",
    description="Book a callback for the customer. CALL it as soon as the person names a day and time inside the allowed window.",
    field_descriptions={"date": "Callback date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be one of the allowed days.",
                        "time": "Callback time as HH:MM, 24 hour, between 10:00 and 19:00."},
    post=fl.ok_post("Callback booked.", "The booking failed. Try schedule_callback once more with the same values."))

nodes["third_party"] = fl.conv(
    "third_party",
    "You called for {{title}} {{last_name}} ({{first_name}}) but someone else is on the line.\n"

    "If they ask what it is about, say you can only discuss it with {{title}} {{last_name}} personally. Do not ask them any security question.\n"

    "- If the day or time is outside the window, say you can only call back today or on the next business day between 10:00 and 19:00, and ask once for another time.\n"
    "- If the second answer is also outside the window, or they cannot say when, do not book: call transition_to_fin_no_callback.\n"
    "After every tool result, speak or call the next tool.",
    tools=[cb_tool],
    extraction=[fl.ext("tp_status", ["none", "wrong_number", "deceased"],
                       "From the person's latest message: wrong_number if they say this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased if they say the customer has died; otherwise none.")],
    transitions=[
        fl.ok_true("schedule_callback", "fin_callback", "callback booked"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "customer died"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.intent_tool("fin_no_callback",
                       "No callback can be booked: the person gave a second time outside the allowed window, or cannot say when the customer is reachable.",

MAX_WRONG = "Three wrong answers. The check has ended. Say nothing about the account."

If they refuse to answer: explain that these questions protect their account, and ask the question again.\n"
